title: pyrethrum trichophyllum
intro: Pyrethrum trichophyllum, commonly known as Chrysanthemum trichophyllum, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the daisy family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its health benefits of reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Pyrethrum trichophyllum include its ability to calm the nervous system, lower fever, and soothe skin irritations. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
